description: Register an https URL to receive events as Standard Webhooks: a POST with webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature (v1, HMAC-SHA256 of id.timestamp.body with the secret returned here, once). scope mine sends your own polls' events, public every public poll's, following those of the polls you follow (a personal account's webhook only); poll_id narrows it to one poll. Choose events [results.changed] to be told only when answers really move. Only events after it is made are sent. Answer 2xx to acknowledge; failures are retried for about three days, and 410 stops deliveries. (POST /api/v1/webhooks)

events.description: Which event types to send. Default: all.

scope.description: mine: your own polls. public: every public poll. following: the polls you follow (follow_poll), from a personal account.

name: create_webhook
title: Create a webhook
